graphify.description: Query or build the project knowledge graph at graphify-out/
graphify.template:
Use the local graphify knowledge graph (graphify-out/: graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md) to answer this. Run the matching graphify CLI subcommand via bash and answer from its output:
- graphify query "<question>" for a focused question (add --budget if truncated)
- graphify path "<A>" "<B>" for a relationship between two symbols/files
- graphify explain "<concept>" for one concept
- graphify . to (re)build the graph from source

Request: $ARGUMENTS
